purpose: Instantiate a meticulous 1000-level, project-scoped self-improvement plane that immediately uses bounded mirror rooms whenever foreground work becomes idle, continuously producing evidence-backed capability improvements without silent production mutation or cross-project leakage.

project_instantiation.rule: The 1000-level ladder is a template instantiated independently for every project. Maturity, evidence, candidates, negative results, capability vectors and promotion receipts are keyed by project identity and cannot satisfy another project's completion state.
project_instantiation.cross_project_transfer: deny-by-default; transfer requires explicit reusable-artifact classification, provenance, compatibility evaluation, privacy/rights checks, adversarial requalification and target-project acceptance

idle_activation.activation: immediate when deterministic idle predicate becomes true
idle_predicate: no unresolved foreground user instruction is awaiting execution
no foreground task owns the project's exclusive mutation lock
no mandatory recovery or safety intervention is active
the foreground runnable queue is empty or blocked only on external/remote dependencies
a mirror-room resource budget is available without violating protected foreground reservations
idle_activation.preemption: new foreground work, safety/recovery work, or an exclusive mutation request immediately cancels or checkpoints the mirror-room epoch and returns protected resources
idle_activation.debounce_rule: debounce may prevent trigger flapping but may not intentionally delay an otherwise eligible idle epoch
idle_activation.continuous_idle_rule: while foreground-idle remains true, bounded improvement epochs may repeat; each epoch must terminate, emit a receipt and re-evaluate the idle predicate before another begins

mirror_room_topology.proposer_room: creates improvement hypotheses and candidate artifacts from a frozen project snapshot
mirror_room_topology.challenger_room: tries to falsify, outperform, break, poison or regress proposer candidates and must produce reproducible counterevidence
mirror_room_topology.role_reversal: proposer and challenger roles rotate for a second independent pass to reduce role-specific blind spots
mirror_room_topology.verifier_room: independently measures baseline versus candidate and cannot grant production authority
mirror_room_topology.archivist_plane: records hypotheses, experiment inputs, results, defeated candidates, negative findings and reusable project lessons
mirror_room_topology.isolation: rooms use disposable branches/worktrees/sandboxes and project-scoped data; no direct write to protected production state
mirror_room_topology.finality: mirror-room consensus is insufficient for production promotion

resource_governance.spare_resource_policy: consume only resources not reserved by foreground/service SLOs or explicit user workloads
resource_governance.no_gain_backoff: repeated no-gain epochs exponentially reduce frequency for that hypothesis family while preserving immediate eligibility for materially new evidence or project changes

promotion_requires: measurable project-relevant gain or risk reduction
held-out or counterfactual evidence where applicable

sequence: consolidate positive and negative project learning

per_project_completion_schema.qualification_rule: A project is PSI-1000-qualified only when all 1000 levels for that exact project identity are simultaneously signed_complete on current evidence. Qualification is revoked when prerequisite evidence, project baseline compatibility or non-compensable invariants become stale.

completion.rule: This file defines the 1000-level template. It does not claim any project has implemented or signed all levels. Project completion is stored separately and must be evidence-bound to the exact project.
